name: Loom
description: Loom is an asynchronous video-messaging platform for recording and sharing screen, camera, and audio walkthroughs. Teams use it to explain work, review ideas, document processes, and collaborate through shareable videos.
agentUseSummary: Loom cannot be connected as an agent provider because it does not offer an open account API; its recordSDK and embedSDK are interactive web integrations rather than delegated account automation.

blocked.label: Connect a Loom account
blocked.description: Loom does not provide a supported OAuth or account API for delegated agent access.

blocked.label: Use Loom account data
blocked.description: Loom does not publish an open API for reading or changing a user's videos, folders, comments, or workspace data.

blocked.label: Run Loom agent actions
blocked.description: The Loom SDK embeds interactive recording and playback UI; it is not an automation API that Relay Console can expose as agent tools.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported Loom account API.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported Loom account API is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported Loom account API is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Loom's official support documentation states that Loom does not offer an open API and that the Loom SDK does not provide API functionality.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Loom only if Atlassian publishes a supported account API or remote MCP service for delegated automation.

evidence.supports: Atlassian's current Loom support article states that Loom does not offer an open API and that Loom SDK is not an open API and does not provide API functionality.
The official SDK FAQ describes a browser-based interactive recording integration authenticated with a developer API key, not delegated access to a user's Loom account or workspace automation.
Loom's developer portal exposes recordSDK and embedSDK for adding recording and playback experiences to web products; it does not document an account automation API.
